story.iWant: to remove pages and routes that are no longer needed (/tickets, /health) and ensure the sidebar navigation only shows active endpoints

task.title: Audit Routes and Decide What to Remove
task.description: List all current routes in the application, document each route's purpose and usage, identify routes that are unused or redundant
task.subtasks: - Verify /tickets page necessity - Determine /health page necessity (API-only vs page) - Check /plugins route usage - Document reasoning for removal decisions

task.title: Remove Unused Routes
task.description: Delete identified unused routes and update layout files
task.subtasks: - Delete /app/dashboard/tickets/ directory (if confirmed unnecessary) - Delete /app/dashboard/health/ directory (if confirmed unnecessary) - Remove any unused route directories - Update layout files and remove unused imports

task.title: Update Sidebar Navigation Component
task.description: Remove menu items for deleted routes and verify accessibility
task.subtasks: - Review Sidebar component (components/dashboard/Sidebar.tsx) - Remove navigation items for deleted routes - Verify aria-current="page" attributes - Test responsive behavior on mobile/tablet

task.title: Verify Navigation and Add Missing Links
task.description: Test all sidebar links and ensure complete navigation structure
task.subtasks: - Test all sidebar links open correct pages - Identify important pages not in sidebar - Add missing primary endpoint links - Verify information architecture

task.title: Run Full Build and Tests
task.description: Verify build and tests pass cleanly
task.subtasks: - Run npm run build - Run npm run test - Verify TypeScript: 0 errors - Manually test navigation

task.title: Documentation
task.description: Document all changes and update story
task.subtasks: - Document route changes in story Dev Notes - List removed routes and reasoning - Document final sidebar structure - Update relevant docs

artifact.reason: Primary navigation component that must be updated. Currently includes /health and /tickets routes in navigationData array (lines 44-90). Must remove navigation items for any deleted routes and verify aria-current="page" attributes (line 115).

System Health Dashboard page displaying health status of API Server, Celery Workers, PostgreSQL, and Redis. Must be evaluated for necessity. Uses useHealthStatus hook and HealthCard component. If kept, ensure it's in sidebar; if removed, delete entire directory.

Ticket Processing Dashboard showing queue depth, processing rate, error rate, and recent activity. Must be evaluated for necessity. Uses useTicketMetrics and useQueueDepthHistory hooks. If kept, ensure it's in sidebar; if removed, delete entire directory.

Contains all route directories. Current routes include: agent-performance, agents, agents-config, audit-logs, execution-history, health, llm-costs, llm-providers, mcp-servers, operations, plugins, prompts, tenants, tickets, tools, users, workers. Each route must be verified as active or marked for removal.
Custom hook used by /health page to fetch system health status. If /health page is removed, this hook may become unused and should be deleted to clean up codebase.
Custom hook used by /tickets page to fetch ticket metrics. If /tickets page is removed, this hook may become unused and should be deleted to clean up codebase.

constraint.name: No Breaking Changes
constraint.description: Route deletion must not break other features or pages. All internal links must point to existing pages.

constraint.name: Accessibility Compliance
constraint.description: Must maintain WCAG 2.1 AA standards established in Story 34. Specifically: aria-current="page" on active nav items, keyboard navigation, semantic HTML.

constraint.name: Design System Compliance
constraint.description: Sidebar component already uses design tokens (text-primary, text-secondary, accent-blue). Do not override these with hardcoded colors.

constraint.name: Build Validation
constraint.description: Must pass npm run build with zero TypeScript errors and zero warnings before commit.

constraint.name: Test Coverage
constraint.description: Existing tests for Sidebar and pages must continue to pass. Update tests if navigation structure changes.

constraint.name: Pattern Consistency
constraint.description: Sidebar structure follows established patterns: category groups with icon + label nav items. Maintain this structure.

interface.name: Sidebar Navigation Component
interface.description: Main navigation sidebar component. Takes no props, uses usePathname() hook internally. Returns aside element with nav sections containing Link components. Must have aria-label attributes for accessibility.

interface.name: NavItem Interface
interface.signature: interface NavItem { label: string; href: string; icon: ReactNode; }
interface.description: Type definition for navigation items in sidebar. Used in navigationData array to define all route links.

interface.name: NavCategory Interface
interface.signature: interface NavCategory { category: string; items: NavItem[]; }
interface.description: Type definition for navigation category groups (Monitoring, Configuration, Operations). Contains array of NavItem objects.

interface.name: Health Status API
interface.description: Returns health status object with api, workers, database, redis fields and timestamp. Used by useHealthStatus hook.

interface.name: Ticket Metrics API
interface.description: Returns ticket metrics including queue_depth, processing_rate_per_hour, error_rate_percentage, recent_tickets. Used by useTicketMetrics hook.

standards.paragraph: Unit testing uses Vitest + React Testing Library for component testing. Integration tests use Playwright for E2E navigation testing. All tests should verify: (1) Sidebar renders correct navigation items, (2) aria-current="page" correctly identifies active route, (3) All href attributes point to existing pages, (4) Links are keyboard accessible (Tab, Enter), (5) No console errors on navigation. Tests should be in __tests__/components/dashboard/Sidebar.test.tsx. Related page tests (__tests__/app/dashboard/health/ and __tests__/app/dashboard/tickets/) should be updated or removed when routes change.

idea.title: Route Audit Test
idea.description: Create test that verifies all routes in navigationData in Sidebar.tsx correspond to actual files in app/dashboard/. Should catch orphaned navigation items pointing to missing pages.

idea.title: Sidebar Navigation Rendering
idea.description: Test that Sidebar component renders only active navigation items and correctly applies aria-current="page" to active link based on pathname from usePathname().

idea.title: Link Validity Test
idea.description: E2E test that clicks each sidebar link and verifies page loads without errors, no 404s, and no broken imports in loaded component.

idea.title: Navigation Coverage Test
